simple.meaning: בֶּזֶק (Bezeq) is a Hebrew word meaning “Bezek , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֶּזֶק (H966) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 1:4, with occurrences in Judges, 1 Samuel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּזֶק (H966) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֶּזֶק (H966) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֶּזֶק (Bezeq) / H966 is traced through Judges 1:4, Judges 1:5, 1 Samuel 11:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

timeline.evidenceText: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

definitions.full: H966. Bezeq בֶּ֫זֶקִ proper name, of a location 1Sam 11:8 ( בְּבָ֑זֶק ) rendezvous of Israel under Saul and Samuel; Judg 1:4-5 , home of Adoni-bezek; on location compare Euseb. Lag Onom. 105, 2nd ed. 139 ; see also Stu. 1:4 ; Judges 17th (mile-)stone from Neapolis toward Scythopolis; modern –irbet Ibzî‡ , 14 English miles from Nâblus, Survey ii. 231 . **Nes AJSL xiii {1897}. 176 conjectures meaning gravel , compare modern Ramle = sand. **Error in 1:4-5 , (see GFM).
